description: Source code for Vulkan QueryPool management in PyTorch's ATen native Vulkan API, including query handling, profiling, and result extraction.

classes.name: QueryPool
classes.description: Manages Vulkan timestamp query pool for profiling GPU shader execution durations, including creation, reset, timestamp writing, result extraction, and reporting.

methods.name: QueryPool
methods.description: Constructor initializing Vulkan query pool and profiling parameters.

methods.name: ~QueryPool
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up Vulkan query pool resources.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the query pool and prepares for new profiling session.

methods.name: write_timestamp
methods.description: Records a timestamp query in the command buffer.

methods.name: shader_profile_begin
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a shader profiling segment, logs kernel info.

methods.name: shader_profile_end
methods.description: Marks the end of a shader profiling segment.

methods.name: extract_results
methods.description: Retrieves and processes query results from Vulkan.

methods.name: generate_string_report
methods.description: Generates a textual report of shader profiling durations.

methods.name: print_results
methods.description: Outputs the profiling report to standard output.

methods.name: get_total_op_ns
methods.description: Calculates total execution time for a specific kernel operation.

methods.name: shader_log_for_each
methods.description: Applies a function to each shader log entry.

methods.name: get_shader_name_and_execution_duration_ns
methods.description: Retrieves shader name and execution duration for a specific query index.

methods.name: shader_logs_entry_count_thread_unsafe
methods.description: Returns the count of shader log entries without thread safety.

methods.name: shader_logs_entry_count
methods.description: Returns the count of shader log entries with thread safety.
